primaryMetric: macro one-to-one exact-span F1 across four mapped types
gate: macro F1 increases and no type loses more than 0.01 absolute exact-span precision; default promotion additionally requires supportive development evidence
developmentEvidence: Candidate has slightly lower macro F1 on development; retain opt-in regardless of a tiny heldout delta. No post-holdout tuning.

holdout.decision: Keep contextual detection opt-in; no default promotion.
